answer: Written in a developer-centric, implementation details matter register, it stays short. The quill of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The sable lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tundra is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on layered finality with probabilistic guarantees.
